headline: Pakistan Government Reduces Petrol and Diesel Prices
summary: The Pakistani government reduced the ex-depot price of petrol by Re 1 per litre and diesel by Rs 2 per litre, according to notifications from OGRA and the Ministry of Energy.
why: Fuel price adjustments impact domestic inflation rates, transportation costs, and energy subsidies in developing economies.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Lower fuel prices reduce transport and consumer energy costs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
